title: Market file
description: One market, at markets/<name>.json: its name, what the dealing is, its roles, the fields of its posts, which of them a preview shows first, and the fields its reviews add. build/README.md explains each part.

name.description: The market's name, the first half of each of its labels, market/role.

description.description: What the dealing is, in one line.

roles.description: The roles a profile here can hold, one profile each. Labels use these words.

post.description: The fields of a post here, by name. The shared names keep their type: description is one text, price is one money.

preview.description: The post fields a post's preview shows first, in order, such as in a search result, a short list or a spoken summary. It names content, never a screen shape. Left out: description, price, then the first field of type place, of those the market has.

items.description: The name of one of the market's post fields; build/check.sh checks that it is.

review.description: The fields a review here holds besides the ones every review holds (subject, score, text and post), by name. Left out: none.

word.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

line.description: One line of text that is not only spaces.

role.description: The role's word, the second half of its labels.

posts.description: What this role's posts are: offers, requests, or just posts.

fields.description: Fields by name. A name is a key in an entry's body: a lowercase letter, then letters and digits, at most 64 characters, and never files, which the standard keeps for the files an entry names.

type.description: One of the nine types in build/types.json.

description.description: What the field holds, in one line.

values.description: For a choice: the values to choose from.

many.description: The field holds a list of its type. Never for words, which is a list already. Left out otherwise.

required.description: An app asks for the field; nothing enforces it. Left out otherwise.

roles.description: The market's roles the field is for: in post, the roles whose posts hold it; in review, the roles of the profile the review is about. Left out: every role.
